question: In evidence.zip, Use all d99-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Collect every nonempty ELF symbol name matching /event_(success|decoy|failure)/, sort strings by ascending code-unit order, join with one LF byte and no trailing LF, then SHA-256 those UTF-8 bytes.

answer_format.syntax: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; no prefix, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: printf %s "$(readelf -W --syms gf_c_events.bin | awk '/Symbol table .\.symtab./{f=1;next} /Symbol table/{f=0} f && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+:$/ && NF>=8 {print $8}' | grep -E 'event_(success|decoy|failure)' | LC_ALL=C sort)" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64
